bundle: Task 1: make the key/pitch rules unbreakable (defense-in-depth, +/-2 semitone cap)
Task 2: Grinder Discord bot UI overhaul (Rythm-style look, purple identity)

decisions.task1_tempo_behavior: LEAVE AS-IS. Founder: 'the BPM stretching is being done currently' -> keep current beat-locked tempo matching; never refuse a pair. Do NOT change tempo/decline behavior.
decisions.task1_pitch_cap: HARD CAP +/-2 semitones, absolute, every layer (decision keys.CAP_SEMITONES, executor mix.KEY_SHIFT_CAP, referee validate.py K1, force-check sweep). The +/-3 empirical leak is the bug to kill.
decisions.task1_untrusted_key_policy: Still measure the shift from audio for unverified keys, but CAP at +/-2 (never >2). Founder: 'closest possible rule, the song has to be made, can't refuse'.
decisions.task1_never_refuse: The app must NEVER refuse to make a pair. Enforce rules as CLAMPS, not gates.
decisions.task1_interpretation_flag: Founder's tempo answer was terse. Interpreted as: keep tempo as-is, fix pitch to +/-2. Low-risk (does not change tempo). Flag in morning report for correction.
decisions.task2_scope: Copy Rythm's LOOK, messages, presentation, flow. Keep Grinder's catalog picker (beat + vocal). NO search-any-song (V1 non-goal).
decisions.task2_identity: Purple 'Electric Violet' (#6d3bf5) matching the web app, across all embeds.
decisions.task2_channels: Commands allowed in ANY text channel; audio playback only in voice channels.
decisions.task2_reference: Rythm music bot screenshots: now-playing card (art + progress + control buttons), help/instructions embeds, queued/now-playing style messages.

hard_constraints: DANGEROUS surfaces (validate.py, render.py) are STAGED, never self-applied overnight (ZUKO_OVERNIGHT).
Task 1 primary fix (pitch cap) lands at non-dangerous layers (mix.py, keys.py, docs, tests, sanity sweep); the referee (validate.py) hardening is staged for the morning tap.
Task 2 (services/discord-bot/) is non-dangerous, additive; the engine is not modified.
Never weaken a test to pass; never change tempo behavior (founder said keep it).
